description: This Dart source file implements a Flutter widget for the 'Add New Card' screen in a mobile application. It includes UI components such as a header, card preview with decorative images, input fields for card details, color selection dots, and action buttons for saving or cancelling. The layout is pixel-precise to match Figma designs, utilizing Stack, Positioned, and custom widgets for form fields and buttons.
